description: Accessible Parking Spaces DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Accessible Parking Spaces on roads and streets. This dataset outlines the disabled parking bays on streets and roads within the Dublin City Council administrative area. Fields include an street name, location and location coordinates for some 501 'General' accessible parking spaces. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are accessible, accessible parking, api, car parking, disability. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, DB_TABLE, GEOJSON, KML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
